subject: Civil Engineering
title: The Silver Bridge Collapse
description: One-minute skill: The Silver Bridge Collapse.

hook.text: On December 15, 1967, the Silver Bridge fell during rush hour. 46 people drowned.

buildup.text: The bridge used eyebar chains instead of wire cables — a less redundant design.

discovery.text: A single eyebar link cracked from corrosion and stress corrosion cracking.

twist.text: One broken link transferred its load to the next. Chain reaction brought it all down.

climax.text: Congress created the National Bridge Inspection Program — every bridge, every two years.

punchline.text: One cracked link killed 46 and changed inspection law forever.

quiz.question: What did the Silver Bridge collapse directly lead to?
options: A nationwide ban on eyebar chain bridges
Creation of the National Bridge Inspection Program
Mandatory replacement of all bridges over 30 years old
